accounting.rationale: J3/24-007 PDF 16, printed 2, lines 1-7 provides the normative-reference policy and four referenced documents. Requirements arise only where later text incorporates referenced content.
The paragraph defines how dated and undated references apply. It does not by itself import every sentence of every referenced standard into a Fortran test oracle.
ISO/IEC 646:1991 is listed as a normative reference for later character-set usage; this list entry is not a standalone Fortran requirement.
ISO/IEC 9899:2018 is listed for later C interoperability references; the list entry does not itself specify any C-interoperability requirement.
ISO/IEC 10646 is listed for later UCS references; the list entry does not itself specify any character semantic requirement.
ISO/IEC/IEEE 60559:2020 is listed for later floating-point references; the list entry does not itself specify any IEEE arithmetic requirement.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clauses 1 and 2 and the compatibility subclauses 4.3-4.3.4 (batch246). Scope and normative-reference text is structural; compatibility statements that restate rules owned elsewhere cross-reference their owners (12.11.5, 19.4, C1598) instead of duplicating them. Source accounting only.
